y="600" /> </Array> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="jW1u8I1_R0t6pFviWmX9-52" value="<h1 style="margin-top: 0px;">Pipeline for citing article summarization</h1><div>This process takes the scoping review as a set of seed documents and searches for citing works from OpenAlex. Citing works will continually change, unlike the seed dataset which is a snapshot of past works. Citing works will change each year as new documents are published. Creating a corpus of new works, the summarization module will take just the key points from each new work and create a summary dataset. The Chat interface can then be used to query this summarized dataset for finding relevant documents and understanding their content.&nbsp;</div>" style="text;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;overflow=hidden;rounded=0;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="80" y="30" width="550" height="140" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>

div.div: This process takes the scoping review as a set of seed documents and searches for citing works from OpenAlex. Citing works will continually change, unlike the seed dataset which is a snapshot of past works. Citing works will change each year as new documents are published. Creating a corpus of new works, the summarization module will take just the key points from each new work and create a summary dataset. The Chat interface can then be used to query this summarized dataset for finding relevant documents and understanding their content.
